test_CausalLM_generate_token: test the CausalLM generate_token method to produce the next token for a CausalLMBatch
test_CausalLMBatch_from_pb: test building a CausalLMBatch from a protobuf batch using the from_pb class method
test_CausalLMBatch_concatenate: test concatenating multiple CausalLMBatch instances into a single batch with merged past key values
test_CausalLM_generate_token_completion: test running CausalLM generate_token in a loop until a request completes and returns generated text
test_CausalLMBatch_filter: test filtering a CausalLMBatch to keep only specific request IDs after some requests finish
